# Colonel Cupcake — *Fallout: Equestria: Project Horizons*

Colonel Cupcake is the good-hearted, sharp-tongued Equestrian Army officer who oversees Big Macintosh’s elite unit, **Macintosh’s Marauders**, in Somber’s [*Project Horizons*](https://fimfetch.net/story/208056/fallout-equestria-project-horizons). He is a character in that fanfiction’s continuity, not an on-screen *Friendship Is Magic* character. He is remembered for protecting his troops and staying at his post when the war ends.

**Appearance:** A stout brown pegasus with a white mane and tail, a **cake cutie mark**, and a white officer’s uniform. Old photographs show him beside Big Macintosh, with a lime-green pegasus, and celebrating his ten-year run as a Guard cupcake-eating champion.

**Name, voice, appearances:** “Colonel Cupcake” is the name used in the original story, not a later fandom nickname; no verified earlier name or alternate identity was found. He is introduced through a portrait and military records in Chapter 13, discovered dead at Miramare Air Station in Chapter 14, and **speaks directly** in a memory-orb flashback in Chapter 70. As a prose character, he has no verified official screen voice actor.

## Important moments

- **Recognizes Macintosh’s leadership — Chapter 13, “Turnabout.”** After repeated losses of assigned lieutenants, Cupcake urges the army to promote Big Macintosh rather than leave its most effective unit without proper command. [Read the chapter](https://fimfetch.net/story/208056/fallout-equestria-project-horizons/13).
- **Defends a fallen soldier — Chapter 14, “Strength.”** Blackjack finds Cupcake’s furious unsent letter defending Big Macintosh’s funeral and the resignation paperwork Macintosh had entrusted to him. [Read the chapter](https://fimfetch.net/story/208056/fallout-equestria-project-horizons/14).
- **Orders a mother to safety — Chapter 70, “Calm.”** During the balefire attack, he relieves Twist of duty so she can save her daughter Peppermint, then remains behind at Miramare to restore communications; they part with a hug. [Read the chapter](https://fimfetch.net/story/208056/fallout-equestria-project-horizons/71).
